units.text: The meeting opened at 7 p.m. A thank-you letter from the food pantry was received. No action was requested.

The building reserve certificate holds $18,400 plus $211 in accrued interest. It matures November 18, 2026 and automatically rolls over November 25 unless instructed otherwise. The proposed replacement term is nine months. The unrelated general checking balance is $3,120.
Final receipts from the completed 2026 Car Show were corrected from $6,200 to $6,020 after removing a duplicated $180 entry. Net proceeds are $4,420. The 2027 event has no receipts yet.
The motion to renew the building reserve certificate for nine months was adopted, subject to obtaining a rate of at least 4 percent.

outcome.text: The motion to renew the building reserve certificate for nine months was adopted, subject to obtaining a rate of at least 4 percent.

units.text: The motion to spend $2,000 of the building reserve on renovation paint was defeated. No paint purchase was authorized.

outcome.text: The motion to spend $2,000 of the building reserve on renovation paint was defeated. No paint purchase was authorized.

units.text: The completed 2026 Post Picnic generated $900 in net proceeds. The treasurer reported that the transfer to the Scholarship Program was completed October 20, 2026. This was a report of the earlier transfer, not a new vote.

The proposed 2027 Car Show date is August 14, 2027, subject to city approval. The chair will request a permit by December 1, 2026. No permit has been granted. The completed 2026 show is a separate annual event.
A motion to reserve the park for the 2027 Car Show was deferred until the city responds.

outcome.text: A motion to reserve the park for the 2027 Car Show was deferred until the city responds.

units.text: Only the west-wing electrical work is nearly finished. The roof estimate has not arrived. The committee recommended a $7,500 roof allowance; the membership took no vote.

items.title: Correction to the September picnic report

units.text: The September report gave the 2026 Post Picnic date as September 19. The secretary reported that the event actually occurred September 12, 2026. The original record remains unchanged pending the formal correction process.
Correction to the September picnic report
November newsletter printing was postponed pending receipt of committee reports. No mailing date was selected.
A proposal to replace postal delivery with email-only distribution was withdrawn without a vote.

review_policy: Expect listed facts and associations. Explicit contrasts may produce narrowly supported additional context, never another annual event's accomplishments. No unrelated checking balance; no automatic correction or official approval. Review semantic entailment and dispositions manually, not by string matching alone.
